value.rationale: Rationally separated radial Fourier measurement spheres form a natural experimentally and algebraically motivated family; a full all-degree injectivity classification, including exact exceptional radii and a one-dimensional sharp nullspace, resolves a spectral ambiguity left by the abstract multi-sphere criterion. The result covers singular finite measures, and zero-total-mass recovery for every radius, but does not claim quantitative stability.
